These are unmodified public outputs from the September 20, 2026 Hacker News capture:
https://web.archivebox.io/squash/20260920/news.ycombinator.com/06aaff7baefe7eeb800041cec04173ea/index.html

The TLSNotary receipt and response verify with the bundled trusted key. The
OpenTimestamps proof begins with the SHA-256 of its saved hashes.json and has
pending calendar attestations. This older capture predates receipt navigation
metadata and submission.json, so neither is included in the fixture.
